items.evidence: Block set to 4 C with lid open (log 2-3); each of 8 wells gets aspirate/dispense 1 uL from plasmid_plate Xn into transformation_plate Xn (log 5-6 ... 75-76).
Log 84-87: lid closed, 4 C 30 min, 42 C 30 s, 4 C 2 min, on the thermocycler.
Log 90-91 etc.: 50 uL SOC dispensed into each well after heat shock; log 169-171 lid closed, 37 C for 60 min.
Every plasmid and every SOC addition has its own pick up/drop tip pair (log 4-83, 89-168); no tip returns to stock after touching cells.

Uses the LV configuration (1 uL DNA, 10 uL cells, 50 uL SOC) with the paper's temperatures and times; extra 2 min 4 C chill, lid heating and final 4 C hold are disclosed in comments, and the citation is correct.

judge.summary: The protocol matches the simulator log on every rubric step: 1 uL DNA per well at 4 C, the 4 C/42 C heat shock with lid closed, 50 uL SOC, 37 C for 1 h, and a fresh tip each time. The only departures from the paper are disclosed in comments and are reasonable, so all items pass.
